viewOffsetAssemblies.scope: view-only movement of the actual source parent group, including both camera modules and lenses

configuration: Official source default standing configuration, attachments enabled, optional top lidar disabled, hypothetical payload hidden
limitations: Modified licensed visual geometry, not an unchanged OEM model or manufacturer BOM.
Inspection optics, electronics and mounts are supplied procedural concept additions, not verified hardware or CAD.
Invisible optional lidar, its bracket and the hypothetical payload are excluded from the exported default configuration.
Source geometry, material groups and captured static hierarchy transforms are retained; no decimation or independent centering.
This GLB contains no motion controller, physics solver, native CAD, manufacturing tolerance or engineering validation.
